description: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores for various language models across three distinct metrics: Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness. The horizontal axis displays the names of ten language models, listed in descending order based on their Understanding scores, including “gpt-4o-2024-11-20”, “Owen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M”, “Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M”, “gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18”, “interlm3-8b-instruct”, “glm-4-9b-chat-1m”, “Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct”, “Prolong-512k-Instruct”, “Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct”, and “Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct”. The vertical axis represents the performance score, ranging from 0 to 100 with a linear scale and tick labels at 10-unit intervals. Three sets of bars are presented for each model, colored light blue, dark blue, and green, representing Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness respectively. For “gpt-4o-2024-11-20”, the Understanding bar reaches approximately 98.0, the Reasoning bar reaches approximately 66.5, and the Trustworthiness bar reaches approximately 54.6. Conversely, “Llama-3.2.2-1B-Instruct” has Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness scores of approximately 3.1, 7.2, and 1.8, respectively. All bars within each model grouping are arranged side-by-side, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines.
